summaryChanges.summary: Dense connective tissue contains more concentrated fibers. It forms tendons, ligaments, fibrous capsules, and many deep fascial sheets.
The muscular system includes skeletal muscles and their supporting connective tissues. Skeletal muscle contraction produces force, moves the body, and helps maintain posture.

The clitoris is a reproductive organ with an external glans and internal erectile structures, including its body and paired crura. It is included for complete, neutral reproductive anatomy terminology.
